shortAnswers.en: Short answers are enough. Take your time.

testMode.en: Test programme. Use made-up practice details, not real personal or business data.
testMode.sw: Programu ya majaribio. Tumia taarifa za mazoezi, si taarifa halisi za mtu au biashara.

unreviewed.en: The Kiswahili wording is a draft and needs local review.
unreviewed.sw: Maneno ya Kiswahili ni rasimu na yanahitaji mapitio ya wenyeji.

waiting.en: Waiting to send. Your answers are saved on this phone.
waiting.sw: Inasubiri kutumwa. Majibu yako yamehifadhiwa kwenye simu hii.

sent.en: Sent. The programme has received your answers.

saveFailed.en: Your latest answers could not be saved. Keep this page open and download a copy.
saveFailed.sw: Majibu yako ya mwisho hayajahifadhiwa. Usiufunge ukurasa huu. Pakua nakala.

serviceUnavailable.en: The application service cannot be reached. Try again when connected.
serviceUnavailable.sw: Huduma ya maombi haipatikani. Jaribu tena ukiwa na mtandao.

entryText.en: Use your finished chapters to get an entry code. Finishing lets you apply; it does not promise a grant.
entryText.sw: Tumia sura ulizomaliza kupata msimbo wa kuingia. Kumaliza hukuruhusu kuomba; hakuhakikishi ruzuku.

importHint.en: Choose the game record files you saved. Use records for one learner.
importHint.sw: Chagua faili za kumbukumbu ulizohifadhi. Tumia kumbukumbu za mwanafunzi mmoja.

codeReady.sw: Msimbo wako wa kuingia uko tayari

keepCode.en: Write down this code. Use it once to start your application.
keepCode.sw: Andika msimbo huu. Utumie mara moja kuanza ombi lako.

keyHint.en: This key opens your private application. Keep it safe. Use it if you change phones.
keyHint.sw: Ufunguo huu hufungua ombi lako binafsi. Uuhifadhi salama. Utumie ukibadilisha simu.

consentRecords.en: Share only these game records with this programme.
consentRecords.sw: Shiriki kumbukumbu hizi tu za mchezo na programu hii.

consentInfo.en: Recipient: {recipient}. Stored for up to {days} days from entry. Questions or deletion: {contact}.
consentInfo.sw: Mpokeaji: {recipient}. Huhifadhiwa hadi siku {days} tangu kuingia. Maswali au kufuta: {contact}.

sampleContact.en: Ask the person running this test

consentFinance.en: I agree to send these business figures and answers for assessment. The programme may use its configured AI service to assess them.
consentFinance.sw: Nakubali kutuma takwimu na majibu haya kutathminiwa. Programu inaweza kutumia huduma yake ya AI kuyatathmini.

consentPhoto.en: I agree to share the attached picture with the programme and its assessor.
consentPhoto.sw: Nakubali kushiriki picha iliyoambatishwa na programu na mtathmini wake.

rules.en: You can get help to read, translate or type. The facts and reasons must be yours. Do not ask AI to make the answers for you.
rules.sw: Unaweza kupata msaada wa kusoma, kutafsiri au kuandika. Ukweli na sababu lazima ziwe zako. Usiombe AI ikutengenezee majibu.

penaltyRule.en: Confirmed AI-made answers lose their marks. Repeated cheating can stop you moving to the next stage. You can explain or challenge a finding.
penaltyRule.sw: Majibu yaliyothibitishwa kutengenezwa na AI hupoteza alama. Udanganyifu wa kurudia unaweza kuzuia hatua inayofuata. Unaweza kueleza au kupinga uamuzi.

followup.en: Two checks and a game question
followup.sw: Maswali mawili na swali la mchezo

awaitingGrant.en: Your application is with the programme. If you receive a grant, your report dates will appear here.
awaitingGrant.sw: Ombi lako liko kwa programu. Ukipokea ruzuku, tarehe za taarifa zitaonekana hapa.

correctionReason.en: Why are you correcting this report?

originalKept.en: The first report is kept. This sends a correction beside it.
originalKept.sw: Taarifa ya kwanza itabaki. Hii itatuma marekebisho kando yake.

reviewHint.en: You can change an answer before you send it.
reviewHint.sw: Unaweza kubadilisha jibu kabla ya kulituma.

unknownHint.en: Leave the amount empty if you do not know yet. Enter 0 only for nothing.
unknownHint.sw: Acha kiasi wazi kama bado hujui. Weka 0 tu kama hakuna.

field.business.en: What do you sell, or want to sell?
field.business.sw: Unauza nini, au unataka kuuza nini?

field.action.en: What will you try in the next two months?
field.action.sw: Utajaribu kufanya nini katika miezi miwili ijayo?

field.success.en: How will you know it worked?

field.openingCash.en: How much business money is there at the start?
field.openingCash.sw: Kuna pesa kiasi gani za biashara mwanzoni?

field.customers.en: How much will customers pay you?

field.added.en: Other money added: grants, loans or your own money
field.added.sw: Pesa nyingine zilizoongezwa: ruzuku, mikopo au pesa zako

field.costs.en: How much will you pay out for the business?

field.drawings.en: How much will you take home?

actual.customers.en: How much did customers pay you?

actual.added.en: How much other money came in?

actual.costs.en: How much did you pay out for the business?

actual.drawings.en: How much did you take home?

field.closingCash.en: How much business money is left now?
field.closingCash.sw: Pesa kiasi gani za biashara zimebaki sasa?

field.basis.en: What did you use to estimate customer payments?
field.basis.sw: Ulitumia nini kukadiria malipo ya wateja?

field.spendItem.en: What would you use the grant for?

field.spendAmount.en: How much of the grant would you use for this?
field.spendAmount.sw: Ungetumia kiasi gani cha ruzuku kwa hili?

field.grantReason.en: What would this help you do?

field.records.en: How will you keep a record?

field.contact.en: How can the programme contact you?

contactHint.en: Use a phone number or email you can access. It is not verified by this form.
contactHint.sw: Tumia namba ya simu au barua pepe unayoweza kufikia. Fomu hii haiithibitishi.

help.person.en: Someone helped me explain my own facts

field.owedByCustomers.en: How much do customers still owe you?

field.owedToSuppliers.en: How much do you still owe suppliers?
field.owedToSuppliers.sw: Bado unadaiwa kiasi gani na wasambazaji?

field.stock.en: What did the stock you still hold cost?
field.stock.sw: Bidhaa ulizonazo bado ziligharimu kiasi gani?

field.equipment.en: How much did you spend on equipment in this period?
field.equipment.sw: Ulitumia kiasi gani kwa vifaa katika kipindi hiki?

field.debt.en: How much loan money do you still owe?
field.debt.sw: Bado unadaiwa kiasi gani cha mkopo?

moreMoney.en: Other money, stock or unpaid amounts
moreMoney.sw: Pesa nyingine, bidhaa au kiasi kisicholipwa

moneyHint.en: The amounts cover the whole two months. Money left is not profit.
moneyHint.sw: Kiasi kinahusu miezi miwili yote. Pesa iliyobaki si faida.

field.basisAnswer.en: Why did you choose that estimate?

basisPrompt.en: You expected {amount} from customers in the first two months. Explain where that number came from.
basisPrompt.sw: Ulikadiria {amount} kutoka kwa wateja katika miezi miwili ya kwanza. Eleza kiasi hicho kilitoka wapi.

changePrompt.en: A customer now pays one month later. What happens to the money you need to keep working?
changePrompt.sw: Mteja sasa analipa mwezi mmoja baadaye. Nini kinatokea kwa pesa unazohitaji kuendelea kufanya kazi?

field.gameAnswer.en: What did that decision teach you for your own business?
field.gameAnswer.sw: Uamuzi huo ulikufundisha nini kwa biashara yako?

field.result.sw: Nini kilitokea baada ya mabadiliko hayo?

field.nextCustomers.en: Customer payments you expect in the next two months
field.nextCustomers.sw: Malipo ya wateja unayotarajia katika miezi miwili ijayo

field.nextCosts.en: Business payments you expect in the next two months
field.nextCosts.sw: Malipo ya biashara unayotarajia katika miezi miwili ijayo

field.evidenceNote.en: What record helps show what happened?

field.source.en: Where did these numbers come from?

source.mixed.sw: Baadhi ya kumbukumbu na baadhi ya makadirio

field.learned.en: What would you do differently now?

field.bottleneck.en: What is stopping your business now?

field.nextGrantUse.en: What would the next grant help you do?

photo.en: Add one record photo, if useful
photo.sw: Ongeza picha moja ya kumbukumbu, ikiwa itasaidia

photoHint.en: No faces or private account details. A notebook or receipt is enough. A photo is optional.
photoHint.sw: Bila nyuso au taarifa binafsi za akaunti. Daftari au risiti inatosha. Picha si lazima.

example.business.en: Say what you sell and who pays for it. A few words are enough.
example.business.sw: Sema unauza nini na nani analipia. Maneno machache yanatosha.

example.action.en: Name one action, such as asking a buyer to pay for a small trial.
example.action.sw: Taja hatua moja, kama kumuomba mnunuzi alipe jaribio dogo.

example.money.en: Practice example: start with 10, receive 5 and pay 4. You have 11 left. These are example numbers, not your business figures.
example.money.sw: Mfano wa mazoezi: anza na 10, pokea 5 na lipa 4. Unabaki na 11. Hizi ni namba za mfano, si takwimu za biashara yako.

example.basis.en: You could use a recent sale, a customer order or a small test. Say if it is only a guess.
example.basis.sw: Unaweza kutumia mauzo ya karibuni, agizo la mteja au jaribio dogo. Sema kama ni makisio tu.

example.grant.en: Name the main use. The form shows how much you would keep for later.
example.grant.sw: Taja matumizi makuu. Fomu inaonyesha kiasi utakachohifadhi kwa baadaye.

example.risk.en: Name one thing that could change and what you would do about it.
example.risk.sw: Taja kitu kimoja kinachoweza kubadilika na hatua utakayochukua.

example.records.en: A notebook is fine. Say what you will write down and when.
example.records.sw: Daftari linafaa. Sema utaandika nini na lini.

example.reflection.en: Say what happened, why you think it happened, and what you did. An honest problem is useful information.
example.reflection.sw: Sema kilichotokea, kwa nini unadhani kilitokea, na ulichofanya. Tatizo lililoelezwa kwa ukweli ni taarifa muhimu.

check.cashGap.en: Your estimate leaves a cash gap of {amount}. Explain how you would handle it.
check.cashGap.sw: Makadirio yanaacha upungufu wa pesa wa {amount}. Eleza utakavyoushughulikia.

check.unknownCash.en: Some amounts are unknown, so money left cannot be calculated yet.
check.unknownCash.sw: Baadhi ya kiasi hakijulikani, hivyo pesa iliyobaki haiwezi kuhesabiwa bado.

check.unknownBalance.en: Some amounts are unknown. The cash balance is not checked yet.
check.unknownBalance.sw: Baadhi ya kiasi hakijulikani. Salio bado halijakaguliwa.

check.cashDifference.en: Your recorded money left differs from the calculation by {amount}. Explain or correct the difference.
check.cashDifference.sw: Pesa iliyobaki uliyorekodi inatofautiana na hesabu kwa {amount}. Eleza au sahihisha tofauti.

grade.pending.en: Your answers are received. Assessment is waiting.

grade.unavailable.en: Your answers are safe. Assessment needs another attempt or a reviewer.
grade.unavailable.sw: Majibu yako yako salama. Tathmini inahitaji jaribio jingine au mtathmini.

grade.completed.en: Assessment complete. This is not a funding promise.
grade.completed.sw: Tathmini imekamilika. Hii si ahadi ya fedha.

criterion.transfer.en: Using a lesson from the game

ready.en: Suggested for progression; a programme decision is still needed.
ready.sw: Umependekezwa kuendelea; uamuzi wa programu bado unahitajika.

needs_evidence.en: More evidence or review is needed.

not_ready.en: Not yet recommended for progression. Read the reasons below.
not_ready.sw: Bado hujapendekezwa kuendelea. Soma sababu hapa chini.

saveOnline.en: Save a copy with the programme

savedOnline.en: A draft copy is saved with the programme.
savedOnline.sw: Nakala ya rasimu imehifadhiwa kwa programu.

useServerDraft.en: Use the draft saved with the programme

backup.en: Download a copy from this phone
backup.sw: Pakua nakala kutoka kwenye simu hii

signOutHint.en: This removes private portal data from this phone. Keep your return key first. Unsent work needs a saved copy.
signOutHint.sw: Hii huondoa taarifa binafsi za programu kwenye simu hii. Hifadhi ufunguo wako kwanza. Kazi ambayo haijatumwa inahitaji nakala.

deleteHint.en: This deletes your application, reports and assessments from this service. Your game records stay on your phone. Backup copies follow the stated retention policy.
deleteHint.sw: Hii hufuta ombi, taarifa na tathmini zako katika huduma hii. Kumbukumbu za mchezo hubaki kwenye simu. Nakala za akiba hufuata sera ya uhifadhi.

adminGrantHint.en: Record an actual grant receipt. This does not send money.
adminGrantHint.sw: Rekodi kupokea ruzuku halisi. Hii haitumi pesa.

adminRecoveryHint.en: Verify the recovery request independently first. Issuing a new key disables the old key.
adminRecoveryHint.sw: Thibitisha ombi la kurejesha ufikiaji kwanza. Kutoa ufunguo mpya huzima wa zamani.

error.invalid.en: Check this answer and try again.
error.invalid.sw: Angalia jibu hili na ujaribu tena.

error.invalidCode.en: That entry code was not found. Check it and try again.
error.invalidCode.sw: Msimbo huo haujapatikana. Uangalie na ujaribu tena.

error.unauthorized.en: Use your return key to open your application again.
error.unauthorized.sw: Tumia ufunguo wako wa kurudi kufungua ombi tena.

error.consent.en: Read and tick the sharing and assistance choices before sending.
error.consent.sw: Soma na uweke alama kwenye chaguo za kushiriki na msaada kabla ya kutuma.

error.finishChapters.en: Finish all required chapters before getting an entry code.
error.finishChapters.sw: Maliza sura zote zinazohitajika kabla ya kupata msimbo.

error.recordUnsupported.en: These game records cannot be checked by this programme version. Keep a copy and ask the programme for help.
error.recordUnsupported.sw: Kumbukumbu hizi haziwezi kukaguliwa na toleo hili. Hifadhi nakala na uombe msaada wa programu.

error.mixedProfiles.en: Use completed chapters from one learner only.
error.mixedProfiles.sw: Tumia sura zilizokamilika za mwanafunzi mmoja tu.

error.alreadyClaimed.en: These records already have an entry code. Use the code or return key you kept.
error.alreadyClaimed.sw: Kumbukumbu hizi tayari zina msimbo. Tumia msimbo au ufunguo uliohifadhi.

error.expired.en: This code has expired. Ask the programme for help.
error.expired.sw: Msimbo umeisha muda. Omba msaada wa programu.

error.usedCode.en: This code has already been used. Use your return key.
error.usedCode.sw: Msimbo huu umetumika. Tumia ufunguo wako wa kurudi.

error.conflict.en: Another saved version exists. Keep your local copy and reload before replacing it.
error.conflict.sw: Kuna toleo jingine lililohifadhiwa. Hifadhi nakala yako na upakie tena kabla ya kubadilisha.

error.alreadySubmitted.en: This has already been sent. Open the sent copy or make a report correction.
error.alreadySubmitted.sw: Hii tayari imetumwa. Fungua nakala iliyotumwa au sahihisha taarifa.

error.notFunded.en: Report dates appear after the programme records your grant.
error.notFunded.sw: Tarehe za taarifa huonekana baada ya programu kurekodi ruzuku yako.

error.notDue.en: This report is not due yet.
error.notDue.sw: Muda wa taarifa hii bado haujafika.

error.finishApplication.en: Finish the application and follow-up questions first.
error.finishApplication.sw: Maliza ombi na maswali ya ziada kwanza.

error.finishReports.en: The final report is needed first.

error.rateLimited.en: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
error.rateLimited.sw: Majaribio ni mengi. Subiri dakika moja na ujaribu tena.

error.tooLarge.en: This file is too large. Use a smaller copy.
error.tooLarge.sw: Faili hii ni kubwa sana. Tumia nakala ndogo.

error.invalidEvidence.en: Choose an exact excerpt from the submitted answer.
error.invalidEvidence.sw: Chagua nukuu sahihi kutoka kwenye jibu lililotumwa.

error.busy.en: Assessment is already running. Try again shortly.
error.busy.sw: Tathmini inaendelea. Jaribu tena baada ya muda mfupi.

error.serverError.en: The service could not finish. Your local copy is still available.
error.serverError.sw: Huduma haijamaliza. Nakala yako ya simu bado ipo.

error.photo.en: Use a JPEG or PNG photo under 10 MB.
error.photo.sw: Tumia picha ya JPEG au PNG iliyo chini ya MB 10.

error.storageConflict.en: Another tab changed your saved work. Download a copy before reloading.
error.storageConflict.sw: Kichupo kingine kimebadili kazi iliyohifadhiwa. Pakua nakala kabla ya kupakia tena.

restoreHint.en: Connect to the internet to check your key and restore your saved answers.
restoreHint.sw: Unganisha intaneti ili kukagua ufunguo wako na kurejesha majibu yaliyohifadhiwa.

declaredAnswerHelp.en: The participant declared help generating answers. Check which answers were affected.
declaredAnswerHelp.sw: Mshiriki ametaja msaada wa kutengeneza majibu. Chunguza majibu yaliyoathiriwa.

sampleAI.en: Not selected for a participant programme
